dialogues.en: "Uhnn..."
dialogues.text: "Uhnn..."

dialogues.jp: ピッ。
dialogues.en: --*Beep*
dialogues.text: --*Beep*

dialogues.jp: 「夢は……見なかったか」
dialogues.en: "I didn't... see any dreams."
dialogues.text: "I didn't... see any dreams."

dialogues.jp:
もっとも、あの能力は、毎晩発揮されていたわ
けではない。むしろ、何も見ない夜の方が多かっ
た。
dialogues.en:
Of course, that power doesn't happen every night. There's
been several nights that I had a perfectly restful sleep.
dialogues.text:
Of course, that power doesn't happen every night. There's
been several nights that I had a perfectly restful sleep.

dialogues.jp: けれど……。
dialogues.en: But...
dialogues.text: But...

dialogues.jp:
もう、他人の夢を覗き見ることはないだろう
……そんな気がしてならなかった。
dialogues.en:
I somehow got the feeling that just maybe, I'd entirely lost
the power to see other people's dreams...
dialogues.text:
I somehow got the feeling that just maybe, I'd entirely lost
the power to see other people's dreams...

dialogues.en: "Now then..."
dialogues.text: "Now then..."

dialogues.jp: 身支度を整え、学園へと向かう。
dialogues.en: I started getting dressed for school.
dialogues.text: I started getting dressed for school.

dialogues.jp: 「到着、と」
dialogues.en: "I'm here..."
dialogues.text: "I'm here..."

dialogues.jp:
自分の席に座る。半ば習慣のようにして、こと
りの席へ目が行った。
dialogues.en:
I sat at my desk. Out of habit, I glanced towards Kotori's
desk.
dialogues.text:
I sat at my desk. Out of habit, I glanced towards Kotori's
desk.

dialogues.jp:
ことりはまだ来ていないらしい。ぽつんとした
空白がそこにある。
dialogues.en:
It looks like Kotori hasn't came yet. All that was there was
a blank space.
dialogues.text:
It looks like Kotori hasn't came yet. All that was there was
a blank space.

dialogues.jp: （俺よりも遅いなんて、珍しいな……）
dialogues.en: "(She's practically never later than me...)"
dialogues.text: "(She's practically never later than me...)"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はい、おはよー。席に着いてー」
dialogues.en: "Alright, good morning~ Return to your desks please."
dialogues.text: "Alright, good morning~ Return to your desks please."

dialogues.jp:
そして、ことりが来ないまま、ホームルームが
始まった。
dialogues.en: And homeroom started without Kotori having arrived.
dialogues.text: And homeroom started without Kotori having arrived.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、暦先生、ちょっと」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, Koyomi-sensei, just a minute."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, Koyomi-sensei, just a minute."

dialogues.jp:
職員室だか、生物準備室だかへと戻っていく暦
先生の背中に呼びかける。
dialogues.en:
I caught Koyomi-sensei just before she started leaving for
either the staff room or the biology room.
dialogues.text:
I caught Koyomi-sensei just before she started leaving for
either the staff room or the biology room.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　ああ、朝倉か。ことりのこと？」
dialogues.en:
"Hm? Ahh, Asakura. You want to know about Kotori, I
presume?"
dialogues.text:
"Hm? Ahh, Asakura. You want to know about Kotori, I
presume?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はい。休み……ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Yes. Is she... resting?"
dialogues.text: "Yes. Is she... resting?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「うん……何だか、体調がすぐれないってね。
　ベッドから出ようとしないんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah... her condition really does seem bad. She couldn't
even get out of bed."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah... her condition really does seem bad. She couldn't
even get out of bed."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「医者に行くようには言っておいたけど……一
　体、どうしちゃったのやら」
dialogues.en:
"I tried to get her to go to a doctor, but... just what is
going on with her..."
dialogues.text:
"I tried to get her to go to a doctor, but... just what is
going on with her..."

dialogues.jp:
両手を広げ、ため息をつく。それは、心配を包
み隠すポーズだったのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
She spread her arms out in disgust and sighed. But I knew it
was her way of concealing her concern.
dialogues.text:
She spread her arms out in disgust and sighed. But I knew it
was her way of concealing her concern.

dialogues.jp: 「後で、様子を見に行って構いませんか？」
dialogues.en: "Can I go see her later?"
dialogues.text: "Can I go see her later?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ああ。まあ、そうしてやってくれる」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, why don't you do just that?"
dialogues.text: "Ahh, why don't you do just that?"

dialogues.jp:
それじゃ、と呟き、暦先生は廊下を去っていっ
た。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei then left down the corridor.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei then left down the corridor.

dialogues.jp: その背中が、妙に小さく見えてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I watched her back get smaller and smaller, thinking to
myself.
dialogues.text:
I watched her back get smaller and smaller, thinking to
myself.

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりが欠席◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori's Absence◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori's Absence◆

dialogues.jp:
ホームルームが始まっても、ことりの姿が見え
なかった。
dialogues.en: Homeroom had started, but Kotori wasn't around.
dialogues.text: Homeroom had started, but Kotori wasn't around.

dialogues.jp:
暦先生に｛たず／訊｝ねると、体調がすぐれず、今日は欠
席らしい。
dialogues.en:
When I asked Koyomi-sensei, she said that Kotori's condition
was bad, so she took absence from school.
dialogues.text:
When I asked Koyomi-sensei, she said that Kotori's condition
was bad, so she took absence from school.

dialogues.jp: 後で様子を見に行こう。
dialogues.en: I decided to check on her later.
dialogues.text: I decided to check on her later.
